intro: Six quick questions so the host can give you a character you'll enjoy. There are no wrong answers, and nobody else sees them.

questions.label: Spotlight
questions.prompt: The host asks someone to read the opening announcement to the whole room. You…
options: Quietly hope someone else volunteers.
Would do it if nobody else wants to.
Happily put your hand up.
Are already standing on a chair.

questions.label: Acting
questions.prompt: Your character card suggests an accent and a signature catchphrase. You…
options: Would rather just be myself with a new name.
Might try the catchphrase once or twice.
Would commit to it for most of the night.
Would rehearse it in the car on the way over.

questions.label: Investigating
questions.prompt: A torn letter is found under a cushion. You…
options: Let someone else deal with it.
Have a look if it's passed to me.
Try to piece it together.
Photograph it, take notes and compare the handwriting.

questions.label: Bluffing
questions.prompt: Someone asks your character a question your character must not answer truthfully. You'd feel…
options: Uncomfortable. I'd rather not have to lie.
Fine with a small fib if it's written for me.
Happy to bluff my way through.
Delighted. Keeping a straight face is my favourite part.

questions.label: Secret missions
questions.prompt: Your card gives you a secret mission: swap two objects without anyone noticing. You…
options: Would rather skip it and just enjoy the evening.
Would give it a go if it's easy.
Would enjoy sneaking around a bit.
Want three missions and a decoy.

questions.label: Preparation
questions.prompt: Before the party, how much reading and prep are you up for?
options: None. Tell me what I need on the night.
A quick five-minute read.
A page or two, and maybe a costume.
Send me everything. I'll study it.

limits.help: The killer has to keep a big secret and bluff all night.
For example a secret affair or a flirtation with another character.
